text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—Rounding the fourth corner!
Now entering the Fuchu homestretch!! The final showdown!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Now, let's go—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: To expand the possibilities!!!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ――O O O O O H H H ! ! !

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Here comes Bubble! It's Bubble!!
Bubble takes the lead!! Bubble Gum Fellow!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Bubble Gum Fellow crosses the finish line!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: The victory is MIIIIINE!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOH!!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ――...A complete defeat.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Air Groove—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Just for today, there are no excuses to be made.
After all, your final run—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Because I was shown that dream, after all.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Saying things like "I want to show potential like you do"—
it completely shook my heart.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: But next time, it's my turn.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Brace yourself. The upcoming run of the 'Empress'
shall show you an 'ideal' that will never fade.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Haha—
Now that's what I'm talking about...!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Let's run again, Air Groove!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"I know that through each other's running,
we can become stronger than ever...!"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
—Yeah.
We will definitely run together again.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOH!!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Truly... how should I put it...—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Ah—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From Bubble Gum Fellow's eyes,
beads of light spilled over.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Before long, they converged into lines, spilling over from her eyes as if catching the brilliance of the evening sun.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Haha, that's weird...
I can't stop...—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Somehow... deep in my chest... my heart is stirring...――

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: "To think that I've been able to prove my strength like this... an unshakeable strength..."

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: "I" am... my strength is—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: It didn't pop and disappear, did it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That Bubble Gum Fellow—that the Heavenly Kings—
were by no means fleeting, ephemeral bubbles—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The dependable way she carries herself now
proves it beyond a doubt...!"
choice_data_list: You have always been, and will always be, eternal!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ...I'm making a declaration.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Bubble Gum Fellow will continue to carve out the future together with you.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: To keep making our dreams swell bigger and bigger!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...I bump my fist against hers.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, she declared.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"As her Trainer, I vowed
to keep dreaming alongside her—"
